messages:
maria (AE): Ok team — FinData pilot kickoff. CTO wants vector search + rerank + tool calls for account enrichment. Need scope, success criteria, model fit (32k context), security answers, and a price estimate for a 3-week pilot. Timeline target: start Mon 4/10. Thoughts?

leo (SE): @maria noted. Quick clarifying q: expected QPS? avg doc length? If docs are >1000 tokens we'll chunk and retrieve. For rerank I'd do embeddings + lightweight cross-encoder on top.

maria (AE): they're expecting ~50k documents, average 800 tokens, spikey traffic (50-200 QPS during demo).

sam (SRE): For 200 QPS at low latency we should plan Dedicated pool. Also recommend KV cache for repeated prefixes. p95 latency target?

maria (AE): CTO wants interactive feel — p95 < 700ms on search+rerank path. Acceptance: accuracy on retrieval QA >= 0.78, rerank MRR improvement > 12% vs baseline.

leo (SE): Proposed plan:
1) Ingest + vector index (week1)
2) Eval harness + prompt set (week2)
3) Tune model routing + canary (week3)
I'll craft eval prompts. Need golden labels (prefer 300 queries).

sam (SRE): Model candidates:
- redwood-32k-embed (embed-only)
- redwood-gen-32k-q4 (generation + tool-calling)
- small cross-encoder for reranking (on CPU)
Quantization + batching to reduce cost.

nina (Security): They requested SCCQ v3 and KMS/HSM details. Also want data residency in eu-west-1 for pilot data. We'll need to confirm Private vs Dedicated + contract addendum.

maria (AE): Security says no PII leaves their VPC. They prefer Private deployment but open to Dedicated with strict network egress controls.

leo (SE): Implementation notes: tool-calling for account enrichment -> use function calls; keep sensitive lookups on customer side and return minimal tokens. Example call:
```json
{
  "name":"fetch_account",
  "args":{"account_id":"<id>"}
}
```

sam (SRE): Cost sketch: assuming 50k docs ingest (~40M tokens of context), plus 10k queries during pilot. With batching + q4 quant, estimate ~$4.5k for 3 weeks on Dedicated. If Private on customer infra, infra costs separate.

maria (AE): Good. I'll send that number to procurement and flag security ask. @nina can you start SCCQ response? @sam can you put together Dedicated vs Private one-pager for legal/comms?

nina (Security): On it. I'll drop answers into the drive spreadsheet and ping procurement. Need contact for customer infra team.

sam (SRE): I'll assemble a short runbook and model routing preference list. Also will prepare eval harness skeleton — need prompt list from @leo.

leo (SE): Working on prompts today. Will aim to deliver 300 labelled queries by Thursday. :thumbsup:

maria (AE): Thanks — plan looks good. Action items summarized:
- leo: prompt set + 300 labels (due Thu)
- sam: Dedicated vs Private one-pager + runbook (due Fri)
- nina: SCCQ responses + KMS details (due Wed)
- maria: update procurement & schedule kickoff for Mon 4/10
I'll follow up in calendar invite. :calendar: 

sec-bot: SCCQ document uploaded to /shared/finData/SCCQ_v3.xlsx (link sent to nina).
